cues.en: I just wanted to give you a brief note about making mistakes.
cues.zh: 我想先簡短談一下犯錯這件事。

cues.en: And when I'm working in a language like Python that is not strictly typed, I tend to make more mistakes than I normally do when I'm working in C, or Go, or Rust, or something like that.
cues.zh: 使用 Python 這種型別限制不那麼嚴格的語言時，我往往比寫 C、Go、Rust 等語言時犯更多錯。

cues.en: And it's really easy to make them. OK?
cues.zh: 這些錯真的很容易發生。

cues.en: And I'm not going to try to hide them.
cues.zh: 而我不會試圖把它們藏起來。

cues.en: When I make a mistake, I will draw to your attention.
cues.zh: 如果我犯了錯，就會特別提醒你。

cues.en: And there will undoubtedly be several occasions during the course of this course where I make a mistake and I don't discover that I've made that mistake until I'm editing the video.
cues.zh: 課程中難免會有幾次，我犯了錯，直到剪輯影片時才發現。

cues.en: And I won't fix it and hide that.
cues.zh: 我不會偷偷修好，再把錯誤藏起來。

cues.en: At the beginning of the next lecture, I'll simply draw that to your attention.
cues.zh: 我會在下一堂課開頭，直接提醒你注意。

cues.en: And in lots of cases, the mistake will be one that I made and you did not. OK?
cues.zh: 很多時候，可能只有我犯了那個錯，你並沒有。

cues.en: So, making mistakes are a normal part of software development.
cues.zh: 犯錯是軟體開發很正常的一部分。

cues.en: And anyone that tells you they're not making mistakes, well, they're probably just lying. OK?
cues.zh: 如果有人說自己完全不會犯錯，那大概是在說謊。

cues.en: I'm not going to do that.

cues.zh: 沒有人是完美的，包括我在內。
